mathematical_review: The graph orientation is consistent: source-state j to target-state i iff P_ij>0. With K=P^T, K_ij=P_ji is the row transition probability from i to j; the closure test K_ij=0 for i in C, j outside C forbids edges leaving C. The two-way reachability condition R_ij and R_ji correctly identifies SCC membership. Checked source lines 27–33 and the individual tile; no existing diagram is present.

The segment residual direction is flow endpoint Phi_{s_{i+1}-s_i}(u_i) minus next node u_{i+1}, with 0≤i<N; the terminal block B(u_0,u_N) uses x_N−x_0 and phase psi(x_0). The augmented field (theta f(x),0) preserves theta along each segment. The normalized midpoint residual is (u_{i+1}−u_i)/h−f_tilde((u_i+u_{i+1})/2), also with 0≤i<N. Signs, domains, indices, and square dimension match source lines 37–49. No existing diagram is present.

The displayed barrier event is inf B≤c (downward crossing); the formula exp(−2(x−c)(y−c)/h) uses nonnegative endpoint distances and gives 1 when either endpoint lies on the barrier. The reflection proof maps the downward crossing to a centered bridge maximum event with positive level x−c. Checked source lines 30–36, 52–60 and individual tiles; no existing diagram is present.
